# Node tools

14 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `add_node`

Add a new node as a child in the active scene (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | yes | Parent node path relative to scene root (use '.' for root) |
| `node_type` | `string` | yes | Node class name, e.g. 'Sprite2D', 'CollisionShape2D', 'RigidBody3D' |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node. Defaults to the node type. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_type": "Label",
  "node_name": "LabelA"
}
```

## `delete_node`

Delete a node and its children from the active scene (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node relative to scene root |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/02-scene.json`, test S-09c:

```json
{
  "node_path": "PrefabInstance"
}
```

## `duplicate_node`

Duplicate a node and all its children (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node to duplicate |
| `new_name` | `string` | — | Name for the duplicate. Defaults to original name + '2'. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "LabelRenamed",
  "new_name": "LabelCopy"
}
```

## `move_node`

Move a node to a different parent or reorder it within the same parent (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node to move |
| `new_parent_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the new parent node |
| `index` | `number` | — | Child index position within the new parent (-1 = last) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-14:

```json
{
  "node_path": "LabelCopy",
  "new_parent_path": "TestBtn"
}
```

## `rename_node`

Rename a node in the active scene (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node to rename |
| `new_name` | `string` | yes | New name for the node |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-04:


## `get_node_properties`

Get editor-visible properties and their current values for a node. Pass 'names' to read specific properties — a bare node reports ~40 of them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node |
| `names` | `array` | — | Only return these properties, e.g. ['position', 'scale']. Omit for all of them. Names that do not match are listed back under 'not_found'. Array items are `string`. |
| `include_categories` | `boolean` | — | Include property category headers in output (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-02:

```json
{
  "node_path": "LabelA"
}
```

## `set_node_property`

Set a property on a node. Godot types can be passed as strings: 'Vector2(10, 20)', '#ff0000', 'Color(1,0,0)' (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node |
| `property` | `string` | yes | Property name, e.g. 'position', 'modulate', 'scale' |
| `value` | any | yes | New value. Pass strings for Godot types: 'Vector2(10,20)', '#ff0000' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "LabelA",
  "property": "text",
  "value": "Hello"
}
```

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-11:

## `connect_signal`

Connect a signal from a source node to a method on a target node (supports UndoRedo)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `source_node_path` | `string` | yes | Node that emits the signal |
| `signal_name` | `string` | yes | Signal name, e.g. 'pressed', 'body_entered' |
| `target_node_path` | `string` | yes | Node that receives the signal |
| `callback_name` | `string` | yes | Method name on the target node to call |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/03-node.json`, test N-13:

```json
{
  "source_node_path": "TestBtn",
  "signal_name": "pressed",
  "target_node_path": ".",
  "callback_name": "queue_free"
}
```
